name: app-store-listing-screenshot-styles-comparison
title: App Store listing screenshots in bold poster styles
whatItIs: A diagonal-split collage of App Store pages: a dark 'Your App' template with blue placeholder screenshots, and listings with vibrant screenshot posters such as purple and orange sound equalizers, a translation app with a rainbow globe, and a photo-led memory app.
whatItMeans: Shows how the listing itself is a design surface; big headlines in screenshots sell before anyone reads.
techniques: Turn each screenshot into a mini poster with a bold headline above a phone.
Use a consistent gradient background across a screenshot set.
Mix illustration, real photography or 3D depending on the app's voice.
Use a diagonal cut to compare styles.

vocabulary.definition: A marketing image displayed in an app listing.
Big text above a phone in a screenshot.
The store page describing an app.
Two areas divided by an angled line.
